vba_code = r'''Option Explicit

Sub HighlightCombinationsInTargetRange()
    'Find every combination of numeric cells in column A whose sum is between
    'LOW_TARGET and HIGH_TARGET, then highlight all cells participating in any
    'valid combination. Multiple valid combinations are all handled.
    
    Const LOW_TARGET As Double = 994108
    Const HIGH_TARGET As Double = 994112
    Const SOURCE_COL As String = "A"
    Const FIRST_ROW As Long = 1
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, SOURCE_COL).End(xlUp).Row
    
    Dim vals() As Double, addrs() As String
    Dim n As Long, r As Long
    
    For r = FIRST_ROW To lastRow
        If IsNumeric(ws.Cells(r, SOURCE_COL).Value) And Len(ws.Cells(r, SOURCE_COL).Value) > 0 Then
            n = n + 1
            ReDim Preserve vals(1 To n)
            ReDim Preserve addrs(1 To n)
            vals(n) = CDbl(ws.Cells(r, SOURCE_COL).Value)
            addrs(n) = ws.Cells(r, SOURCE_COL).Address(False, False)
            ws.Cells(r, SOURCE_COL).Interior.Pattern = xlNone
        End If
    Next r
    
    If n = 0 Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim chosen() As Boolean, found As Collection
    ReDim chosen(1 To n)
    Set found = New Collection
    
    SearchSubset vals, addrs, chosen, found, 1, n, 0#, LOW_TARGET, HIGH_TARGET
    
    Dim combo As Variant, a As Variant
    For Each combo In found
        For Each a In Split(CStr(combo), ",")
            If Len(a) > 0 Then
                ws.Range(a).Interior.Color = RGB(0, 176, 80) 'green
            End If
        Next a
    Next combo
    
    MsgBox found.Count & " combination(s) found.", vbInformation
End Sub

Private Sub SearchSubset(ByRef vals() As Double, ByRef addrs() As String, _
                         ByRef chosen() As Boolean, ByRef found As Collection, _
                         ByVal i As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal runningSum As Double, _
                         ByVal lowTarget As Double, ByVal highTarget As Double)
    Dim j As Long, s As String
    
    If runningSum >= lowTarget And runningSum <= highTarget Then
        For j = 1 To n
            If chosen(j) Then s = s & addrs(j) & ","
        Next j
        found.Add Left$(s, Len(s) - 1)
        'Do not Exit Sub here if negative numbers are possible.
        'For all-positive data, uncommenting the next line avoids supersets:
        'Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If i > n Then Exit Sub
    
    'Prune only when all remaining values are non-negative.
    If runningSum > highTarget Then Exit Sub
    
    chosen(i) = True
    SearchSubset vals, addrs, chosen, found, i + 1, n, runningSum + vals(i), lowTarget, highTarget
    
    chosen(i) = False
    SearchSubset vals, addrs, chosen, found, i + 1, n, runningSum, lowTarget, highTarget
End Sub'''
